name: Evard's Black Tentacles
summary: 20-foot square of tentacles: Difficult Terrain; Str save or 3d6 Bludgeoning and Restrained.
text: Writhing black tentacles fill a 20-foot square of ground within range, making it Difficult Terrain for the duration. Each creature in the area makes a Strength saving throw; on a failure it takes 3d6 Bludgeoning damage and has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A creature also makes the save when it enters the area or ends its turn there, but no more than once per turn. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
